# Code Map — Dispatcher (Admin Web App / Dispatch Console)

Next.js 16 / React 19, frontend-only prototype on mock data. components/Console.tsx is the
shell (TopBar + NavRail + screen switch, state in lib/nav.ts). Styling is inline style
objects driven by lib/theme.ts tokens — no Tailwind/CSS modules.

- data.ts holds ALL mock data (the API seam — never invent endpoint shapes) · types.ts entity types · theme.ts color/typography tokens (extend it, no ad hoc colors) · nav.ts screen-switch state.
- billing/accruals.ts and reports/terminus.ts are the pure period→figures report derivations; the screen, the printed sheet (documents/accrualsPdf, documents/terminusPdf) and the clipboard export all consume them rather than recompute.
